Offered a lucrative contract, but someone else already has it? Before you step in, there’s a serious legal risk many business owners overlook: tortious interference.

Even if you do everything “by the book,” you can still face exposure if you knowingly replace an existing vendor or contractor. Written communications, ignored contract terms, or pressuring a party to terminate can all be used against you.

The smart move?

 ✔️ Review the existing contract
 ✔️ Understand the exit provisions
 ✔️ Avoid unnecessary communications
 ✔️ Talk to a business lawyer before you act

When the contract is valuable, the risk may be worth it, but only if you understand the consequences first.

Standar Desain dan Pemasangan Patok Pengarah Jalan Raya

Patok pengarah (delineator) adalah perangkat lalu lintas yang dipasang di sisi jalan untuk meningkatkan keselamatan berkendara, terutama pada tikungan. Dilengkapi reflektor merah (kiri jalan) dan putih (kanan jalan) yang memantulkan cahaya lampu kendaraan, patok ini berfungsi sebagai panduan visual bagi pengemudi di malam hari atau kondisi jarak pandang terbatas. Jarak pemasangan antarpatok ditentukan berdasarkan radius tikungan: semakin tajam tikungan, semakin rapat jarak pemasangan.
